label: When the equation gives a function
section: When the equation gives a function
subgoals: Look at a contour of the equation
Require a nonzero partial in the dependent variable

visual.title: A level set as a graph
visual.caption: A contour of F(x, y) = 0 is locally a curve. When the partial in y is nonzero, that curve can be read as y as a function of x, which is what the implicit function theorem promises.

predict.question: F(x, y) = 0 defines y locally as a function of x when:
predict.explain: The theorem needs a nonzero partial in the dependent variable. With F_y ≠ 0 the contour can be solved for y near the point.
